query:
SELECT p.id, p.filename, p.category, p.createdAt, fsd.id as fileSearchDocId
FROM protocols p
LEFT JOIN fileSearchDocuments fsd ON p.id = fsd.protocolId
WHERE p.trialId = 'def-456'
ORDER BY p.createdAt DESC;
